reddit.title: Introducing New Features in Provincia: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We're excited to share some new features that enhance interaction with your colony in Provincia! With thought badges on settlers, a streamlined problem-alert system, and dynamic construction feedback, your settlement will communicate its needs more effectively. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
